objective: Choose line overcurrent relay pickup current and time delay that avoid load operation, operate for minimum internal faults, and coordinate with downstream protection.
hard_constraints: Pickup current must be at least max_load_current_a multiplied by load_margin_multiplier.
Minimum-fault sensitivity factor min_fault_current_a / pickup_current_a must be at least min_sensitivity_factor.
Time delay must be at least downstream_time_delay_s plus selectivity_margin_s.
Secondary relay pickup and time delay must stay within published device ranges.

metrics.name: feasible
metrics.description: Whether pickup, sensitivity, selectivity, and relay range constraints are all satisfied.

metrics.name: sensitivity_factor
metrics.description: Minimum internal fault current divided by pickup current.

metrics.name: secondary_pickup_a
metrics.description: Relay secondary pickup after CT conversion.

metrics.name: score
metrics.description: Normalized [0,1] score: 1 minus scaled slack penalties if feasible, else 0.
